measurement.units: bytes; MB uses 1000000 bytes; KiB uses 1024 bytes
measurement.memory: Refreshed GetAddOnMemoryUsage counters for the four product packages. The original cached read is retained but excluded from fresh baseline summaries.
measurement.gcPolicy: No explicit collection or changes to collector policy in any live probe in this investigation.
measurement.naturalSampling: No product method wrappers or business actions during the two 110-second observations. The second run was opened by the user and included actual applicants. Each sample refreshes global addon memory; that observer cost is recorded separately.
measurement.profiles: Separate 15-second diagnostic windows temporarily wrapped product methods and the library event handler, restoring all wrappers at cleanup. Heap deltas are net changes, include nested calls and natural collection, and must not be summed across parent/child methods or interpreted as gross allocations.
measurement.scope: The before/after live windows differ in group size, event counts and global GC state. No percentage improvement is inferred. Two 110-second sampled peaks do not establish an indefinite peak or a full automatic GC cycle.

rootCause.summary: Any local social change rebuilt every relationship source. Guild identity indexing materialized full ClubMemberInfo tables for 979 members; repeated guild and Battle.net updates drove fast temporary allocation growth.

changes: Invalidate character friends, Battle.net and guild independently.
Read guild full name and GUID from scalar roster returns.
For a valid friend index, refresh only that friend; list/count changes and events without a usable index refresh the complete Battle.net source.
Keep only current normalized Battle.net identity keys/GUIDs, preserve other source bits, and release all relationship indexes when inactive.

skippedCycleAttempt.reason: The user had already ended recruitment and closed the page. This attempt did not collect a cycle and is not a passing run.

errors.coverage: All 42 retained provider rows; one historical stack/locals pair was truncated. Message, session, counter and time were present and unchanged.

groupRegression.coverage: 1000 guild members, 500 Battle.net friends; source isolation, indexed updates and full fallbacks, offline identities, overlap, duplicates, short-name ambiguity, cleanup and native record release.

observationLifecycle.coverage: Normal/repeated observation, budget failure, absent events, scene exit, initial and callback observer failures, cancellation, and late callback cleanup.
